# Psalm 128 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-song of-the-ascents. Blessed every-one fearing YHWH, the-walker in-his-ways.

**2** The-labor-of your-hands indeed you-will-eat; blessed you and-good to-you.

**3** Your-wife like-a-vine fruitful in-recesses-of your-house; your-children like-shoots-of olives around your-table.

**4** Behold for so will-be-blessed the-man fearing YHWH.

**5** May-bless-you YHWH from-Zion, and-see in-good-of Jerusalem all days-of your-life.

**6** And-see children to-your-children. Peace upon Israel.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **128:3**: Vine and olive shoots — images of fertility and generational continuity; domestic prosperity as covenant blessing.

— EMET
